manageMenu.empty.title: Build your menu in a few seconds
manageMenu.empty.body: Take a photo of your menu board, take a screenshot of your existing menu, or drag in a PDF — our AI extracts everything and builds your digital menu automatically.
manageMenu.empty.note: Works with photos, screenshots, PDFs and plain text. Before saving you can review and edit everything.
manageMenu.category.countsTitle: Counts toward the kitchen capacity limit (set it in Menu → Kitchen capacity)

manageMenu.uncategorized.title: Uncategorised
manageMenu.uncategorized.body: ⚠ No category set — choose a category (✏️) so each item shows in its own section. Until then they are still live on the order screens.
manageMenu.newCategory.title: New category
manageMenu.newCategory.notesTitle: Allow customer notes on each item
manageMenu.newCategory.notesHelp: Lets customers add a note to each item (e.g. “no onion”). The food truck can always add item notes anyway. All orders also have a notes field for the whole order.
manageMenu.allergens.heading: Allergens
manageMenu.allergens.buildFirst: First build your menu — add dishes, then set their allergens
manageMenu.allergens.cardNotAllowed: Because an allergen card alone cannot be used where your food truck sells, customers see the allergens right beside each dish. Please confirm each dish’s allergens.
manageMenu.allergens.addCard: add an allergen card so that customers can see allergen information
manageMenu.allergens.viewOnly: View only — only the owner can change allergens
manageMenu.allergens.uploadIntro: Upload your allergen card, or paste your allergen information. Our AI extracts it and arranges it clearly for customers.

manageMenu.allergens.needReview: {count, plural, one {Dishes to review: #} other {Dishes to review: #}} — customers cannot see allergen information until confirmed
manageMenu.deleteItem.title: Remove: {name}?

manageMenu.deleteItem.body: This item will be hidden from your menu straight away. It does not show on the customer order page or in the “+ Add order” panel.

manageMenu.item.createHint: Fill in the details, then add the item.
manageMenu.item.ingredientsHelp: Shown to customers on the order page

manageMenu.item.photoHint: Square photos are best. JPG or PNG.
manageMenu.item.preorderHelp: Include this item in pre-orders. The timing and rule are set for everything together in Settings → Pre-orders.

manageMenuImport.settingsReview.title: A few settings to check

manageMenuImport.allergensNotSet.title: ⚠ Allergens and dietary are not set yet
manageMenuImport.welcome.title: Welcome to HatchGrab

manageMenuImport.welcome.body: {name} — set up. Next we add your menu, then your first event.

manageMenuImport.review.title: Review the imported menu

manageMenuImport.review.editLater: Names, prices, extras, allergens and dietary information can all be changed any time in Settings.
manageMenuImport.review.noPrice: {count, plural, one {Items whose price we could not read: #} other {Items whose price we could not read: #}}
manageMenuImport.review.lastCategory: Your menu needs at least one category

manageMenuImport.schedule.photoTitle: Upload a photo of my schedule
